notes: Read all 111 source lines before editing. Module is the shared dashboard 'ranked list' presenter (a pure presentational component): a vertically scrollable list sorted by value desc, capped at a limit, with an optional translucent rank bar, rank number, truncated label, optional badge, and right-aligned formatted value; its purpose and layout are preserved in the native header comment.

Imports (L1-4): React + useMemo + type ReactNode (L1) kept. @/components/ui Badge (L2) has no DOM in native -> inlined as a local native pill backed by theme tokens (mirroring the sibling WidgetBigNumber/ProjectedRangeWidget ports). @/components/feedback EmptyState (L3) -> the already-ported native parity EmptyState (web-parity/components/feedback/EmptyState) which accepts the same icon + message props plus a native style. @/lib/cn (L4) -> dropped (React Native has no class names); the cn('...bar...', item.barColor ?? 'bg-blue-400') merge becomes a StyleSheet style + a dynamic { backgroundColor } override.

RankedItem interface (L6-13): ported verbatim -> id: string|number (L7), label: string (L8), value: number (L9), formattedValue: string (L10), badge?: {text; variant: 'success'|'warning'|'error'|'neutral'} (L11), barColor?: string (L12). barColor now carries a native color string instead of a Tailwind class (web default 'bg-blue-400' -> native '#60a5fa', captured by the DEFAULT_BAR_COLOR constant), documented inline on the prop.

WidgetRankedListProps interface (L15-22): ported verbatim -> items (L16), maxItems? (L17), compact? (L18), showBars? (L19), emptyMessage? (L20), emptyIcon?: ReactNode (L21). One native-only optional prop (testID?: string) is added without breaking any web call site, for native testing.

badgeVariantMap (L24-29): ported as a typed Record<'success'|'warning'|'error'|'neutral', BadgeVariant> with the same mappings (success->success, warning->warning, error->danger, neutral->neutral). The web `as const` object becomes an explicitly typed Record so the inline native Badge variant union is enforced at compile time.

Component signature + defaults (L31-38): export function WidgetRankedList with destructured defaults preserved -> compact = false (L34), showBars = true (L35), emptyMessage = 'No data available' (L36). emptyIcon (L37) is threaded straight into the parity EmptyState's icon slot.
limit + hideBars (L39-40): preserved verbatim -> limit = maxItems ?? (compact ? 3 : 5); hideBars = compact || !showBars.
visible useMemo (L42-45): preserved verbatim -> [...items].sort((a,b) => b.value - a.value).slice(0, limit) with deps [items, limit]; the immutable copy keeps the source's non-mutating sort.
maxValue useMemo (L47-50): preserved verbatim -> visible.reduce((max, item) => Math.max(max, item.value), 0) with deps [visible].

Empty branch (L52-54): web returns <EmptyState icon={emptyIcon} message={emptyMessage} className='py-8' /> -> <EmptyState icon={emptyIcon} message={emptyMessage} style={styles.empty} />. The web className='py-8' overrides the EmptyState default py-16 (32px vs 64px); styles.empty sets paddingVertical: 32 to reproduce exactly that override on the parity EmptyState (whose default container is paddingVertical 64). The web no-action transient empty-state comment intent is preserved (no action/actionTo passed).

List container (L56-58): web <div className='overflow-y-auto'><ul className='flex flex-col gap-1'> -> a ScrollView (the native overflow-y-auto analog, same idiom as the sibling ProjectedRangeWidget Range Factors list) whose contentContainerStyle={styles.list} supplies the gap-1 (4px) vertical row gap, collapsing the div+ul pair into one scroll container.

Row map + barPct (L59-66): visible.map((item, index) => ...) preserved; barPct = maxValue > 0 ? (item.value / maxValue) * 100 : 0 kept verbatim and carried into a typed `const barWidth: DimensionValue = `${barPct}%`` (same idiom as ProjectedRangeWidget's fillWidth). Each web <li key={item.id} className='relative min-h-[44px] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--surface-2)]'> -> a keyed <View style={styles.row}> (position relative, minHeight 44, borderRadius 8, paddingHorizontal 12, paddingVertical 8, justifyContent center). The hover:bg-[var(--surface-2)] affordance has no native analog and is intentionally dropped; transition-colors is a CSS-only concern and also dropped.

Background bar (L67-76): web {!hideBars && <div className=cn('absolute inset-y-0 left-0 rounded-lg opacity-15', item.barColor ?? 'bg-blue-400') style={{width: barPct%}} />} -> {!hideBars ? <View style={[styles.bar, {backgroundColor: item.barColor ?? DEFAULT_BAR_COLOR, width: barWidth}]} /> : null}. styles.bar = position absolute, top/bottom/left 0 (inset-y-0 left-0), borderRadius 8 (rounded-lg), opacity 0.15 (opacity-15). The Tailwind bg class default becomes the native '#60a5fa' (blue-400) constant.

Row content + rank (L78-83): web
-> (flexDirection row, alignItems center, gap 12). web rank {index + 1} -> {index + 1} with styles.rank = width 20 (w-5), textAlign right, fontSize 12 (text-xs), fontWeight '500' (font-medium); tone muted maps text-[var(--text-muted)]. Content is rendered after the absolute bar so it paints on top (no zIndex needed).
Label (L85-88): web {item.label} -> {item.label} with styles.label = flex 1, fontSize 14 (text-sm) and default primary tone; numberOfLines={1} reproduces `truncate`.

Badge (L90-98): web {item.badge && <Badge variant={badgeVariantMap[item.badge.variant]} size='sm'>{item.badge.text}</Badge>} -> {item.badge ? <Badge variant={badgeVariantMap[item.badge.variant]}>{item.badge.text}</Badge> : null}. The web size='sm' (px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-full) is baked into the inlined native Badge styles (paddingHorizontal 6, paddingVertical 2, fontSize 12, fontWeight '500', borderRadius 9999). BADGE_PALETTE maps success/warning/danger/neutral to the successSurface/warningSurface/dangerSurface/surfaceRaised + matching foreground theme tokens.

Value (L100-103): web {item.formattedValue} -> {item.formattedValue} with styles.value = fontSize 14 (text-sm), fontVariant ['tabular-nums'], default primary tone; weight='semibold' maps font-semibold.
Closing JSX + braces (L104-112): the li/ul/div close map to the View/ScrollView close; the map return and component return/brace are preserved.

No DOM elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, framer-motion, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output -- only React, RN primitives (ScrollView, StyleSheet, View, type DimensionValue), the shared apps/native AppText, the parity EmptyState, and theme tokens. Verified from apps/native: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) exit 0, `npm run lint -- --quiet` exit 0, and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` green (added __tests__/WidgetRankedList.test.tsx asserting sort/limit, compact/showBars bar suppression, badge variant mapping, value/rank rendering, and the empty state).
